title: The weather and the seasons
description: Ask about the weather and say what it is like in each season.

blocks.text: To ask about the weather, say Jaka jest pogoda? Many answers start with Jest and an adverb: Jest zimno, Jest ciepło, Jest gorąco. Rain and snow use the verb padać: Pada deszcz, Pada śnieg. The seasons are wiosna, lato, jesień and zima; in a season is wiosną, latem, jesienią and zimą.

blocks.translation: What is the weather like today?
It is warm and the sun is shining.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.translation: What is the weather like today?

lines.speaker: Igor
lines.translation: It is cold and it is raining.

lines.speaker: Igor
lines.translation: Yes, but tomorrow it will be warm.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.text: To dobrze. Jutro idziemy do parku!
lines.translation: That is good. Tomorrow we are going to the park!
